intent: Metrics strip of kit Scorecards: two to six figures, and the only metric picker. Up to six sit in one row; more wrap, and four or more go two by two when the strip is narrow. Framed cards or a divided strip; selectable turns it into a radiogroup that picks what a chart shows.
useWhen: Showing two or more KPIs side by side at the top of a dashboard
Replacing ad-hoc flex rows of metric boxes
Picking which metric a chart shows — selectable
A quiet strip of three to five values with thin rules between them — appearance divided
doNotUseWhen: A single KPI — render Scorecard directly
Vertical stacks of metrics — not supported by this contract

aria-label.note: Names the section, and the radiogroup when selectable.

items.note: 2–6 sit in one row of equal columns (five or six go three to a row below 64rem of strip width). More than six wrap four to a row. Below about 38rem, four or more go two by two; three stack. With selectable, each item's id (or label) is its value. Each item passes its own Scorecard look through (goodWhen, sparklineVariant, reference, compare, highlightLast, sparklineDates, meter), so a strip can mix them.

scroll.note: Deprecated, no effect. Scoreboard no longer composes Conveyor: more figures wrap instead of scrolling.

appearance.note: cards: framed Scorecards with a gap. divided: plain Scorecards with thin border.faint rules between them; when the strip wraps the rules run both ways (two by two on a phone), and three stack with horizontal rules below about 38rem.

selectable.note: The strip becomes a radiogroup named by aria-label. Each card is role radio with aria-checked; one card is in the tab order; arrow keys move and check (wrapping), Home and End jump. The strip sets each card's selected and onClick (an item onClick still runs).

value.note: Controlled checked item: its id, or label. Selectable only.

defaultValue.note: Uncontrolled first checked item. Defaults to the first item. Selectable only.

onValueChange.note: (value: string) => void when the checked item changes.

requirements: Expose aria-label describing the metrics group
Each child Scorecard retains its own semantics
selectable: the card row is role radiogroup named by aria-label; cards are role radio with aria-checked
selectable: roving tabindex, arrow keys move and check, Home/End jump
Pair a selectable strip with a chart titled after the checked metric so the change is announced by context

doNot: Do not invent a local Scoreboard
Do not fake dividers with CSS borders between items — use appearance divided
Do not restyle Scorecard padding or borders inside Scoreboard
Do not inline Scorecard markup — import from ui/Scorecard
Do not build a metric picker from Scorecard toggles by hand — use selectable
Do not use selectable for actions; each card picks a view, it does not navigate
Do not wrap Scoreboard in Conveyor or scroll it sideways — more figures wrap
Do not use Conveyor as a metric picker — use selectable
snippet:
<Scoreboard items={[{ label: 'Revenue', value: '$48.2k', delta: '+12.4%', trend: 'up' }, { label: 'Churn', value: '1.2%', delta: '-0.3%', trend: 'down' }, { label: 'Users', value: '12.4k', delta: '+4.1%', trend: 'up' }, { label: 'NPS', value: '64', delta: '+2', trend: 'up' }]} />

  onValueChange={setMetric}

  ]}
/>
